token.kt_tinggi_huruf_px: min 64 (cap-height ±6 % frame); kata kunci = ukuran sama, warna amber

aturan_teks: Setiap ucapan tampil sebagai SATU lapisan teks kinetik, 1–3 kata per tampil, muncul tepat di onset kata (words.json), bertahan sampai frasa selesai diucapkan.

Posisi dari komposisi shot: di talking head, teks di dinding hijau sisi seberang kepala (Jensen kiri → teks kanan, Jensen kanan → teks kiri); di b-roll, di ruang kosong/menempel subjek. Tidak 3 tampil berturut-turut di pita yang sama.
Teks tumpuk kartu 55 k4 (kata besar ±10 % tinggi di atas kata kecil ±4,3 %, rata kiri) hanya di B1 dan B12.
Maks 2 baris, blok seimbang (baris terpendek ≥ 85 %), tanpa kotak di belakang teks kecuali kontras gagal.
Teks diam di dunianya; kamera yang bergerak melewatinya.

babak.material: cetakan foto/arsip fisik di atas meja kertas gelap #0E0D0C bertekstur, bayangan jatuh, vignette kuat (kartu 55 k5/k6)
monokrom kontras tinggi + grain; satu-satunya warna = amber kata kunci
footage NVIDIA nyata + gelap kontras tinggi

beat.ucapan: People with very high expectations have very low resilience,
beat.visual: Jensen talking head (wajah.mp4 sinkron). Crop 16:9 yang membuang garis putih diagonal kiri atas.
beat.teks: Teks tumpuk di dinding kosong seberang kepala: 'HIGH EXPECTATIONS' (besar, amber) muncul di 'high'@1.12; 'LOW RESILIENCE' (besar, putih→amber pada 'resilience') di bawahnya pada 'low'@2.30; kata sambung 'people with very' / 'have very' kecil di atas masing-masing.

beat.visual: Kartu 55 k1: bingkai foto putih #F4F1EA di atas latar hitam hangat; di dalam bingkai klip wisuda 7712312 lalu 7945851 (wisudawan bertepuk tangan, crop ke bingkai landscape) berganti pada 'success'@5.45.
beat.kamera: push terus-menerus ±5 % lebar/dtk melintasi pergantian klip (bingkai tetap tumbuh).
beat.teks: Di bawah bingkai, rata kiri dengan tepi bingkai: 'unfortunately,' → 'resilience' (amber) → 'matters in success.'

beat.ucapan: I don't know how to teach it to you except for I hope suffering happens to you.
beat.kamera: push pelan 6.05–7.70; di 'I hope'@7.74 punch-in cepat 100→135 % ke wajah (8 frame, ease-out, motion blur) + flash frame putih 1 frame tepat di puncak punch-in.
beat.teks: 'I don't know' / 'how to teach it to you' (kecil) lalu, setelah punch-in, 'I hope SUFFERING happens to you.' di samping wajah, 'suffering' amber.

beat.ucapan: And I was fortunate that I grew up with my parents providing a condition for us to be successful on the one hand,
beat.visual: Babak II: 2–3 cetakan foto arsip Jensen muda/keluarga/NVIDIA awal (frame dari 60 Minutes dan yU3GUHDf0mk, lihat TASK) sebagai foto fisik berbingkai putih di atas meja kertas gelap, bayangan jatuh, vignette. Masuk lewat frame buram→fokus (6 frame).
beat.kamera: satu gerak panjang menyusuri foto (pan + pull pelan) dari foto 1 ke foto 3, tidak kembali.
beat.teks: Chunk 1–3 kata menempel di samping foto yang sedang difokus kamera: 'I was fortunate' / 'I grew up with my parents' ('parents' amber) / 'a condition' / 'to be successful' / 'on the one hand,'
beat.momen: masuk foto (shutter/flash kartu 55 20,4 dtk), foto mendarat.

beat.ucapan: but there were plenty of opportunities for setbacks and suffering.
beat.visual: Babak III: grade monokrom kontras tinggi + grain. 6290471 (pria memegang kepala) 15.29–18.05; di 'suffering.'@18.09 kartu judul satu kata 'SUFFERING' ±50 % tinggi frame, huruf berisi video percikan api forge_35117150 (objek jadi huruf, kartu 55 k2), di latar hitam #0E0D0C sampai 18.7.
beat.kamera: push 100→112 % ke kepala pria; kartu judul pull pelan 104→100 %.
beat.teks: 'but there were' / 'plenty of opportunities' / 'for SETBACKS' (amber) di ruang kosong kiri atas frame; lalu kartu judul (judul = kata yang diucapkan).
beat.momen: pergantian babak (musik ganti/turun ke gelap), snare/glitch di kartu judul.

beat.ucapan: And to this day, I use the phrase pain and suffering inside our company with great glee. And I mean that.
beat.visual: Babak IV: footage NVIDIA dari 60 Minutes (kantor/engineer/chip/HQ, lihat TASK) 2 shot; di 'And I mean that.'@22.86 kembali ke Jensen talking head.
beat.kamera: pan pelan mengikuti subjek di shot NVIDIA; push pelan di Jensen.
beat.teks: 'to this day,' / 'PAIN AND SUFFERING' (amber, satu blok) / 'inside our company' / 'with great glee.' / 'And I mean that.'
beat.momen: tidak ada SFX di cut biasa.

beat.ucapan: Boy, this is going to cause a lot of pain and suffering. And I mean that in a happy way,
beat.visual: 5281595 mengetik di gelap, kontras tinggi 23.88–25.85; lalu Jensen talking head 25.9–27.2 (ekspresi 'happy way').
beat.kamera: push pelan ke tangan; Jensen diam-push pelan.
beat.teks: 'Boy,' / 'this is going to cause' / 'a lot of PAIN AND SUFFERING' (amber) — di Jensen: 'in a happy way,'

beat.ucapan: Because you want to train, you want to refine the character of your company. You want greatness out of them.
beat.visual: Babak V: forge_5846379 (mesin tempa menekan batang logam membara) 27.24–30.70; forge_35117150 percikan api 30.76–32.2.
beat.kamera: push 100→115 % ke batang membara; percikan: push cepat ringan.
beat.teks: 'you want to train,' / 'to REFINE' / 'the CHARACTER' (amber) / 'of your company.' / 'You want GREATNESS' (amber) / 'out of them.' — di ruang gelap atas frame.
beat.momen: hantaman tempa yang terlihat (impact di frame tekan), whoosh/swell di masuk percikan.

beat.ucapan: And greatness is not intelligence. Greatness comes from character.
beat.visual: 6754830 close-up PCB 32.25–33.60 (di 'intelligence'); cut keras ke Jensen talking head close (punch 120 %) 33.67–35.05.
beat.kamera: PCB: slide/pan cepat; Jensen: push pelan.
beat.teks: 'greatness' / 'is not INTELLIGENCE' (putih, kata kunci tidak amber karena kalimat menolaknya) → 'Greatness comes from' / 'CHARACTER.' (amber).

beat.ucapan: And character isn't formed out of smart people, it's formed out of people who suffered.
beat.visual: 20563164 siluet pria di ruang gelap depan laptop.
beat.teks: 'character isn't formed' / 'out of smart people,' / 'it's formed out of' / 'people who SUFFERED.' (amber) — di sisi gelap kosong frame.

beat.ucapan: And so if I could wish upon you, I don't know how to do it. For all of you Stanford students,
beat.visual: Babak VI: Jensen talking head lebar.
beat.teks: 'If I could' / 'wish upon you,' / 'I don't know how to do it.' / 'For all of you' / 'Stanford students,'
